rca_of_issue: Bug RCA: server.py line 797 GET /api/insights called db.mood.find() but mood data is stored in db.moods collection. Motor AsyncIOMotorClient silently creates a new phantom collection named 'mood' on attribute access — returns empty results without error. This caused all mood fields in insights days array to always return null. Fix: changed db.mood to db.moods. Verified by setting mood='Good' via POST /api/mood and confirming insights?period=week returns mood='Good' for today's entry.
